title: Cost-velocity ingest and threshold auto-tuner for tenant-level notifications
creator: Riley Chen
description: Add a first-class stream and pre-aggregation path for per-tenant cost-velocity (rate of cost accrual) and build an automated threshold auto-tuner that reduces false positives for tenant-level notifications. This ticket covers ingestion, enrichment, baseline modeling, threshold auto-tuning, and notification throttling/fingerprint deduplication in the Console backend and Analytics pipeline. Goal: surface only meaningful anomalies (sustained cost spikes or unusually fast cost accrual) to customers and on-call teams while keeping noise within an operational target.
background: Current alerts use static thresholds on daily cost and simple percent-change heuristics which produce noisy alerts for tenants with bursty traffic patterns and for usage patterns tied to seasonality (cron jobs, batch jobs). We need a streaming-first solution that captures cost velocity (cost units per minute/hour) and adapts thresholds per tenant, plan tier, and quota history. The auto-tuner should respect customer preferences (sensitivity low/medium/high) and be safe by default (opt-in to aggressive tuning), with a human-in-the-loop rollback via the Console rollout controls.
acceptance_criteria: A streaming ingestion path (Kafka topic + pre-aggregator) emits tenant-level cost-velocity metrics (1m and 5m windows) into our time-series store (Prometheus/Grafana or ClickHouse) and is documented
Baseline model implemented: hybrid short-window z-score for immediate spikes + EWMA with weekly seasonality component for medium-term drift
Auto-tuner service computes per-tenant thresholds that meet a target false-positive rate (configurable, default 2%) and stores threshold history for explainability
Alerting backend applies deduplication/fingerprint logic (fingerprint keys + suppression windows) to avoid duplicate notifications within a 15-minute dedupe window
End-to-end test harness demonstrating fewer false positives on 6 weeks of historical tenant data (compare current heuristics vs new auto-tuner) with results attached
Grafana dashboards for cost-velocity, threshold history, and alert volume per tenant; links added to ticket
Rollout plan with gradual ramp (canary 5% tenants -> 25% -> 100%) and automatic rollback criteria defined
design_notes: Trade-offs: simple EWMA + seasonality is cheap and interpretable; full ML (isolation forest/AutoML) could catch subtle patterns but adds training ops and latency. We prioritize a hybrid interpretable approach for MVP.

Privacy: only aggregated per-tenant cost-velocity will be stored; raw request traces are not required. Retention defaults to 90 days for thresholds and 365 days for aggregated metrics as per telemetry policy.
Threshold compute location: prefer near-ingest stateless microservice to avoid backpressure on central model store; write thresholds to a small redis cache for alerting service to read with TTL 10m.
implementation_plan: 1) Schema: define cost-velocity metric format and update producer libraries in runtime (tokens_cost, timestamp, tenant_id, plan_tier)
2) Streaming: add Kafka topic kafka.metrics.cost_velocity and lightweight pre-aggregator service (kstream) to emit 1m/5m windows
3) Baseline service: implement hybrid baseline in analytics-workers; expose threshold API
4) Alerting: modify alerts-service to consult threshold API and apply dedupe fingerprinting before sending notifications
5) Testing: replay 6 weeks of historical billing events through the pipeline and evaluate false-positive and detection latency metrics
6) Rollout: canary -> ramp -> full; monitor alert volume and false positives per tenant
updates: 2026-02-18 - Creation: scoped work, identified owner (Marco). Initial spike planned to validate ingestion overhead.
2026-02-24 - Discovery: ran backfill on 3 months of billing events; median cost-velocity distribution computed; heavy tail observed for free-tier tenants due to dev/test bursts.

2026-03-02 - Prototype: pre-aggregator skeleton implemented; emitted 1m windows for 500 tenants in dev cluster. Observed ~8% increase in broker throughput; mitigations: compacted messages and gzip compression.

2026-03-07 - Design review: architecture reviewed with Infra and Security; suggested redis cache for thresholds and a per-tenant rate limit to prevent noisy tenants from spamming alert-service. Action: add quota protection in pre-aggregator (throttle if >10k events/min).

2026-03-10 - Implementation: baseline EWMA + weekly seasonality component merged to feature branch (PR listed below). Preparing replay tests and dashboard templates. Requested product review for default sensitivity setting.
telemetry_queries: clickhouse: SELECT tenant_id, toStartOfMinute(ts) as minute, sum(cost) as cost_amt FROM billing_events GROUP BY tenant_id, minute
bigquery: SELECT tenant_id, TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, MINUTE) as minute, SUM(cost) FROM billing.events GROUP BY tenant_id, minute
notes_for_release_engineering: Heatmaps for message sizes and broker throughput must be reviewed; pre-aggregator deploy must include throttles. Provide migration script to backfill thresholds for active tenants.
